name: satellite-ground-track
description: Ground track console: TLE to Keplerian elements, a day of SGP4 ground track, and Bangkok visibility above a 5 degree mask. Plus a Moon-centred console and an Earth-Moon libration-point view, which are served unchanged from public/.
//: The Earth console is a Svelte 5 + Vite 8 + TypeScript app (src/). Every dependency is pinned exactly:
satellite.js 6.0.1 and three 0.128.0 must not move, because the regression gate is bit-identical and
the globe's palette is tuned to r128; typescript stays on 6.0.x because svelte-check does not accept 7.
verification/ is CommonJS (its own package.json) and drives the built site over http.
legacy/ is the pre-rewrite Earth console, kept until cutover as the A/B and calibration reference.

scripts.gate: npm run build && node verification/regress.js --target new
scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run evec && npm run planner && npm run advisor && npm run gate && npm run refresh && npm run pov && npm run doppler && npm run optical && npm run site && npm run export && npm run catalogue && npm run custom && npm run timeline && npm run elements && npm run lifetime && npm run ar && npm run layout && npm run planner-ui
scripts.test:fast: npm run check:deps && npm run check && npm run check:server && npm run build && npm run build:shims && npm run test:unit && node verification/run.js --fast --target new && node scripts/legacy-manifest.mjs --check
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run build:shims && node verification/run.js
